## CroutonBlockFrame

Shared chrome for editor-block NodeViews (#2414): selected border, label row, edit + delete buttons, double-click to open the property panel. Tiptap stays out of core — the block keeps its own `<NodeViewWrapper>` and renders this inside it. ## CroutonCollectionSkeleton

CroutonCollectionSkeleton Layout-aware loading placeholder for the collection viewer. Rendered as the <Suspense> fallback while the async generated List component resolves its data, so the viewer shows one calm, centered shimmer (sized to match the real layout, avoiding a jump) and then reveals the fully-populated result at once — instead of an empty table that fills in row-by-row. `layout` is a p

## CroutonQrCode

QR Code (`<CroutonQrCode />`) Renders any string (typically a URL) as a scannable QR code. Uses `uqr` to generate an inline SVG — zero runtime dependencies, deterministic, and SSR/prerender-safe (no canvas, no network). The wrapper controls the display size; the SVG scales to fill it.

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `string` | yes | The string to encode (a URL, in most cases). |
| `size` | `number` | no | Rendered size in pixels (square). |

## CroutonSubBar

CroutonSubBar — a thin, presentational secondary bar that sits under a primary toolbar / header. It's a bordered, padded horizontal strip with leading / default / trailing slots, optionally sticky over a scrolling container. It owns ONLY layout: spacing, the divider, background, horizontal-overflow scrolling, (opt-in) sticky pinning, and (opt-in) auto-hide on scroll. It deliberately hosts NO tabs 

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sticky` | `boolean` | no | Pin to the top of the nearest scroll container while content scrolls under it. |
| `bordered` | `boolean` | no | Draw the bottom divider (default true). |
| `autoHide` | `boolean` | no | Hide the bar while scrolling DOWN and reveal it immediately on scroll UP (the mobile-toolbar behaviour). Implies sticky — a non-pinned bar has nothing to hide. No-op on the server. |
| `flush` | `boolean` | no | Bleed out of a host that pads its scroll container (the standard `p-4` pane) so the bar spans the FULL width edge-to-edge — content stays inset to line up with the padded siblings. Use when the bar sits inside a padded scroll area; omit when the host has no horizontal padding (the bar is already full-width then). |

## CroutonTabsPanel

CroutonTabsPanel — the shared shell for a tabbed admin section (Team, Bookings, Sales…): ONE top bar holding the sidebar toggle, the section title and the section's tabs, with the active tab's page below it (#2380). - Phone: menu button + tabs on one row; the title is screen-reader only. Tabs keep their full labels and swipe sideways when they don't fit. - Desktop: title + tabs on the same row. - 

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Section name — shown on desktop, screen-reader only on phones. |
| `tabs` | `NavigationMenuItem[] \| NavigationMenuItem[][]` | yes | The section's tabs (usually `{ label, icon, to }`, `exact` on the index tab), flat or grouped. |
| `maxWidth` | `string` | no | Max width of the content column (left-aligned, so it shares the bar's edge). |
| `fill` | `boolean` | no | Opt-in: bound the body to the panel height (page owns its scrolling) instead of scrolling the whole body. |

## CroutonWorkspaceLayout

CroutonWorkspaceLayout - Reusable split-panel workspace shell Provides the shared layout and state management for page-level workspaces: - Resizable sidebar (UDashboardPanel) + content panel - Selection state machine (view → create → edit) - URL query param sync (?item=<id>) - Mobile: sidebar only, content opens in USlideover - Keyboard shortcuts (N to create, / to search) Consumers provide their 

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `modelValue` | `string \| null` | no | v-model for selected item ID |
| `sidebarId` | `string` | no | UDashboardPanel id for sidebar |
| `queryParam` | `string` | no | URL query param name for selection persistence |
| `title` | `string` | no | Navbar title |
| `sidebarSize` | `number` | no | Default sidebar size as % |
| `sidebarMinSize` | `number` | no | Min sidebar size as % |
| `sidebarMaxSize` | `number` | no | Max sidebar size as % |
| `createShortcut` | `boolean` | no | Enable N keyboard shortcut for create |
| `searchShortcut` | `boolean` | no | Enable / keyboard shortcut for search |
| `contentProvidesBack` | `boolean` | no | The content slot renders its OWN mobile back affordance (via the `onClose` slot prop), so the shell must NOT render its default back bar. Used by the pages workspace, which folds the back arrow into its editor toolbar. Flow leaves this false and keeps the shared back bar. |
